Improving your home shouldn’t feel like a gamble. 

For homeowners seeking home remodeling in Washington, the process starts with a simple goal—more space, better flow, a home that fits how life looks now.  But too often, the decision comes with hesitation. Stories of missed timelines. Vague budgets. Contractors who disappear mid-project. A process that feels stressful instead of exciting. Fairbank Special Services (FSS) is a remodeling contractor in Washington designed to change that experience.

We help homeowners across Bainbridge Island and Kitsap County remodel with clarity, professionalism, and care—so the process feels steady, transparent, and expertly managed from the very first conversation.

A Better Way to Improve Your Home

Most homes weren’t designed for how families live today.

Layouts that once worked now feel cramped or inefficient. Kitchens no longer support daily life. Bathrooms feel dated and unsafe. Storage is an afterthought. And as needs change—working from home, aging in place, hosting family—you may have found that your home no longer supports the way you live.

Moving is always an easy way out. But it often feels like the wrong solution. The cost is high. The stress is real. And there’s no guarantee the next home will be better suited than the one you already love.

Thoughtful home renovation offers a better alternative—when it’s guided by experience and clear planning, giving homeowners control of the process and the outcome.

Our role is to help you improve your home intentionally, addressing real needs while reducing the uncertainty that often surrounds residential remodeling projects.

Remodeling Backed by Fairbank Construction

Fairbank Special Services is the smaller projects division of Fairbank Construction Company. 

Our clients benefit from decades of experience in delivering complex construction projects—applied thoughtfully to residential remodeling services. We bring construction-grade project management into the unique lived-in space requirements of the home. 

What that means for you:

Licensed and insured professionals

Proven processes refined over decades

Clear accountability at every phase

A remodeling company homeowners can count on today and for years to come

You get the depth of a seasoned builder, paired with a residential focus that prioritizes comfort and communication, and that confidently stands behind a warranty of its workmanship. 

Our Remodeling Process

A well-run project feels calm because it’s planned. Our process is designed to reduce friction and anxiety by setting expectations early and consistently managing details.

1

Consultation & Needs Assessment

We listen first. Understanding how you live—and what isn’t working—is the foundation of a successful remodel.

2

Design & Scope Planning

Goals are translated into clear plans with a defined scope to avoid ambiguity later.

3

Clear Budget & Timeline

Before work begins, you’ll understand the investment, schedule, and decision points.

4

Build Phase

Trades are coordinated, work is supervised, and communication stays consistent.

5

Final Walkthrough & Warranty

We review the finished project together and stand behind the work.

Why Homeowners Choose Fairbank Special Services

Although local presence and local knowledge are key considerations, choosing the best remodeling company near you is less about location and more about trust.

Homeowners choose Fairbank Special Services because we turn “Is this possible?” into a clear, achievable plan. By bringing structure and predictability to our clients’ desired outcomes, anticipation replaces anxiety.  

When recalling our partnership in building their comfort upgrades, space transformations, or home glow-ups, most of our clients describe our work in three words: “Well-managed. . .” “Rewarding. . . ” “Easy. . .” 

Just as the structures we build span generations, our relationships with our clients, founded on integrity and mutual trust, last well beyond the project.

About Wolfe Design Build

Wolfe Design Build is a comprehensive, full-service remodeling and design firm based in Swampscott, Massachusetts, focused on larger-scale renovations and whole-home transformations.

Matt Wolfe founded Wolfe Design Build in 2018 after several years working at a high-end custom residential design-build company in Massachusetts. With a vision to create a firm rooted in quality, creativity, and collaboration, he made his dream of running his own company a reality. Since then, Wolfe Design Build has experienced tremendous growth — thanks to our talented team, the craftsmanship we deliver, and the incredible clients we serve.

Based in Swampscott, we primarily work in the surrounding communities, including Marblehead and Melrose. Our expertise spans additions, large-scale home renovations, custom kitchens, and primary suites and bathrooms, along with thoughtful remodels of all sizes.

At Wolfe Design Build, we stand behind a simple philosophy: Do things right. We’re known for innovative design solutions, superior craftsmanship, and exceptional client service. Our integrated team of designers, carpenters, and project managers works closely with you to bring your vision to life while ensuring a smooth, seamless experience.

As a true design-build firm, we are your single source for the entire project. By combining design, construction, and project management under one roof, we eliminate the stress of juggling multiple companies with competing priorities. Instead, we guide you through every step, from the first conversation to the final details.

The process always begins with listening. Your home and goals are our top priority. We’ll meet with you to understand your needs, explore your ideas and inspirations, and help you make thoughtful choices that align with your vision for your home.

Our Team
Matt Wolfe
Founder & Lead Designer

Matt established Wolfe Design Build LLC after 15+ years of experience in design, space planning, construction systems, project management, and cost estimating.

Matt's love for craftsmanship and building began at an early age when he apprenticed as a carpenter and built custom wooden sheds. Since that time, Matt has developed his skills as a craftsman and designer. He earned his Master of Architecture from Syracuse University where he learned innovative practices and gained a deep understanding of architectural design and space planning.

Matt has worked as a site engineer for a commercial construction company and in real estate development. Prior to founding Wolfe Design Build, Matt was a project manager at an award-winning design/build firm on the North Shore.

Matt lives in Swampscott with his wife and two daughters, Ella and Clara, and two golden retrievers named Frankie and Tony.

Matt’s favorite saying is, “We want you to feel like you’ve bought a new home.”

Laura Moretti
Interior Designer & Project Manager

Laura spent most of her career working in fashion for Eileen Fisher. She switched careers a few years ago and started working for a local interior designer. She developed a love for design and for helping clients turn their houses into beautiful homes.

She brings a wealth of design skills and project management experience to Wolfe Design Build. She lives in Swampscott with her twin children, Cam and Izzy, and her rescue dog, Maggie.

Jessica is a registered architect and brings 18 years of experience in planning and design. She previously worked at Arrowstreet in Boston and owned her own architecture firm. She has a degree in architecture from Penn State University.

OUR COMMITMENT TO CRAFTSMANSHIP
A legacy built on trust and skill.

For half a century, we have honed our craft, evolved with the industry, and remained steadfast in our core values.

Generations of Leadership: Founded by Chris’ grandfather, expanded by his father and uncles, and now led by Chris Stebnitz, our family’s dedication to quality spans decades.

Community Focused: From sponsoring local events to supporting non-profits, we believe in giving back to the people and organizations in our community who have supported us.

Award-Winning Service: Recognized locally and nationally for customer satisfaction and design excellence, including multiple GuildQuality Service Excellence Awards.

Investing in People: Our team is our greatest asset. We prioritize training, safety, and career development to ensure the highest level of expertise on every job site.

OUR 5-YEAR WARRANTY
Standing behind our craftsmanship long after the project ends.

While the industry standard is often one year, at Stebnitz Builders we stand apart by offering a comprehensive 5-year Warranty on our workmanship. We believe true peace of mind shouldn’t expire when the trucks drive away. It’s our promise that your remodel is built to last, and if something isn’t right, we will be there to fix it.

Start Your Project with Confidence
A Relationship Built on Trust
WE ARE HERE, READY TO LISTEN—EVEN YEARS LATER.

Remodeling is a significant investment in both your home and your future. You deserve to know that the team you hired has your back. Our 5-Year Warranty is a testament to the confidence we have in our process, our trade partners, and our skilled carpenters. We don’t just build projects; we build relationships. If an issue arises with our installation or craftsmanship within five years of completion, simply call us. We will assess the situation and make it right, ensuring your home continues to perform as beautifully as the day we finished.

WHAT IS COVERED?
Commitment to Our Craft

Our warranty specifically covers defects in workmanship and installation provided by Stebnitz Builders and our subcontractors.

Carpentry & Installation: Issues arising from the installation of cabinets, trim, windows, doors, and framing.

Mechanical Systems: Workmanship related to plumbing, electrical, and HVAC updates performed under our contract.

Exterior Finishes: Installation defects in siding, roofing, and flashing that could lead to leaks or failure.

Structural Integrity: Any issues related to the structural modifications or additions we constructed.

Note: Manufacturer warranties on specific products (appliances, shingles, etc.) are separate and will be passed directly to you.
